decks.notes: This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures for value and dealing damage to the opponent through various triggers such as Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester. The combination of Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven provides constant sacrifice fodder and life gain. Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute help disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating advantage for yourself. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and The Meathook Massacre to deal with threats. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and efficient creature sacrificing.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and powerful green aggro strategy while generating a high devotion to green for additional benefits. The deck aims to ramp up quickly using mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, and then play strong threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn. Storm the Festival and Invasion of Ixalan help to find key pieces of the deck, while Karn, the Great Creator and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx provide additional utility and mana advantage.

This deck aims to quickly ramp into Lotus Field to generate a large amount of mana for explosive plays. It utilizes various cards to untap Lotus Field, allowing for multiple activations in a turn. The deck also includes cards to search for key pieces like Lotus Field and combo finishers. It focuses on casting powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum to win the game in a single turn. The deck's strategy revolves around assembling the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards with the ultimate goal of overwhelming the opponent with a large number of cards and resources. It utilizes the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value and card advantage. The deck includes a mix of counterspells, board wipes, card draw, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria to maintain control of the game. The mana base supports the deck's strategy by providing access to different colors of mana and utility lands.

The deck aims to control the game by utilizing Enigmatic Incarnation to consistently search for powerful creatures to play. With a focus on card advantage and removal spells, the deck seeks to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up its own board presence. The inclusion of Keruga, the Macrosage as a companion allows for additional card draw, while the diverse array of creatures and enchantments provide flexibility in adapting to different matchups. By efficiently managing resources and implementing a strategic game plan, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver opponents in order to secure victory.

The deck revolves around using Enigmatic Incarnation to continuously exchange creatures with different converted mana costs for value and disruption. The deck also focuses on controlling the board with cards like Chained to the Rocks and Leyline Binding, while using Fires of Invention to cast spells for free. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds additional value by flickering permanents. With a mix of powerful creatures and enchantments, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a slower, grindy game.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on strong creatures with haste and big threats that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Esika's Chariot and Reckless Stormseeker, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain board presence throughout the game. The inclusion of cards like The Akroan War and Voldaren Thrillseeker provide additional control and removal options, while the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds a versatile mana source. With a mix of aggression and resilience, this deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and powerful vehicles like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship. The deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure on the opponent, using cards like Lovestruck Beast and Bonecrusher Giant to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds flexibility to the deck and allows for additional options in gameplay. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to the colors needed for the deck's spells and abilities.

The main focus of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board state through targeted discard spells like Duress and Thoughtseize, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill. The deck also aims to generate value through cards like Waste Not and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. Liliana of the Veil provides additional disruption and card advantage. The deck utilizes powerful threats like Tergrid, God of Fright and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet to close out the game. The manabase is built around maximizing black mana sources to support the deck's spells and strategies.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays and disruption, utilizing powerful Rakdos creatures and removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with efficient threats like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. By combining fast clock with disruption, the deck aims to control the pace of the game and secure a victory before the opponent can establish their own game plan.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, using powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly apply pressure to the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide additional threats and graveyard recursion, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker can create more creatures to overwhelm the opponent. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to deal damage quickly and efficiently to secure victory.
